assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:crusch-karsten@light-novel#character-model, the canonical V1.0 Crusch Karsten V01-V16 source-bounded character model at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the admitted Japanese main light novels; the model itself declares that it reconciles already consumed passages of V04, V05, V06, V07, V09 and V16 through thirty-five bounded windows rather than six complete rereads. The project's current-state entrypoint and character-analysis router were read for method, authority order and scope only. The frozen volume readings, the five specialist ledgers and master ledger, the source lock, the separate same-analyst fidelity review, the reconstruction protocol and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; the model's MONOGRAPH_READY label and PASS_WITH_BOUND local verdict are inputs, not conclusions. No V17 or later volume, EX, IF, web-novel, game or anime material is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Ten model-selected states from the retrospectively reported youth (CY) through the V04 public candidate, the V05 private host, the V06 failed negotiator, the V07 bargain and Whale command, the V09 attacked convoy and post-loss council, and the V16 memoryless meeting, with the default fixed at the latest personally observed state: memoryless Crusch at the V16 interrupted breakfast and candidate opposition (C16B). Three histories are kept apart: her own pre-loss experience, that experience as available to the reader and Subaru, and what the memoryless Crusch has relearned or newly chosen. Her E019 location and conduct are unobserved, the late V09 conversation timing is unmarked, V10-V15 supply no selector, and no V17 or later state, recovery of memory, restored governing or martial capacity or in-world date is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a thesis (judgment made answerable to a chosen responsibility, with a severe side in the V06 refusal and a lie-detecting perception that is not a truth oracle), a cross-state motive candidate with its explicit non-predictions (section 4), twenty-four eight-field rules with exceptions and confidence (section 7) and six rival readings with named falsifiers (section 9), routed to thirty located bundles across six volumes including one actual Crusch focalization (E16). The artifact is single, same-analyst reviewed and offers no independent reconstruction test, and the post-loss default rests on eight bundles, so A is not supported; the rule-level inferential structure with falsifiers exceeds specialist interpretation, so C is not supported.

Section 2 gives ten selectors with a memory-loss firewall separating pre-loss experience, reader and Subaru knowledge, and post-loss relearning; discarded states (C05, C06) are marked ONLY_DISCARDED_STATE_EVIDENCE; C09M is used as depicted without an invented replay; and section 1 refuses to make either the old commander or the memoryless woman the authentic self. The late V09 timing is unmarked, V10-V15 are unselected, E019 is unobserved and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the three-history separation is explicit and located, so C is not supported.

Section 8 records twelve exact short Japanese samples spanning all six volumes, with a documented pre-loss versus post-loss contrast (私 and 卿 against ナツキ・スバル様 and careful apologies), the public challenge 問おう, the resolve line 自信などない。あるのは意志だ, the 狂人 label, the accountability line 私には聞く義務がある, the laughing command, the shame maneuver, the post-loss imperative 謝罪しなさい, the competitive joke and the elegant exclusion 無粋な殿方にはお帰りいただいて, each with a conditional function and a denied transfer. The samples are short, no sentence-ending or lexical inventory exists, extended unsampled speech returns JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW and anime delivery is excluded, so B is not supported; the cross-state contrast is located and conditioned, so D is not supported.

Section 5 and bundles E02, E04, E05, E12, E16 and E26-E28 locate the balcony invitation with water rather than forced drink, embarrassment and retaliatory teasing, the palm ritual and lion-hilt habit, bath and rest willingness, the peaceful dinner, competent playful cooking and a hesitantly accepted feeding gesture, each with a stated limit (no favorite food, alcohol tolerance, schedule, bedtime or purchases). The ordinary scenes are few and split across pre-loss and post-loss states, so B is not supported; they are located and dedicated, so D is not supported.

Section 5 differentiates eight recipients, and the Ferris (E01, E05, E12, E14, E23, E27, E28), Wilhelm (E03, E14, E16, E19, E27), Subaru (E06-E11, E13, E15, E17, E18, E22, E26) and Rem (E10, E20-E22) relations are multi-scene, span pre-loss and post-loss states and carry per-recipient memory firewalls; Emilia, Anastasia and Russell, soldiers and public challengers, and the father and unnamed dream person are thinner. Registers are Crusch-side only, the private dream and Fourier report are explicitly ungraded beyond a bounded comparison, and the model says its anchors are not controlled experiments, so A is not supported; four relations have located multi-state conduct, so C is not supported.

One actual Crusch focalization (E16: healer trust, reliance of troops, reciprocal duty, battle resolve, the hilt habit) plus located self-accounts (E03 first expedition, E04 renounced marriage, E13 taxation and security), an owned premature interruption (E11), admitted smile regret (E20) and reduced blessing-control self-report (E27) support inferred interior structure; the model keeps motive rivals live and marks the C06 inner balance INTERNAL_MOTIVE_UNDERDETERMINED. One focalized section and otherwise inference do not support B; a located focalization and several self-accounts exceed distributed evidence, so D is not supported.

Located conflict spans the V06 bounded audience, refusal, probing and spoon threat (E06-E09), the owned interruption and revised estimate (E11), the shame-based morale speech with its instrumental cost (E17), the massacre response with the failed Hundred-Man Strike and severed arm (E21), the post-loss demand that Ferris apologize (E23) and the polite firm public exclusion of Heinkel (E29), modeled by R07, R08, R10, R11, R15, R16, R20 and R24 with exceptions. The artifact is single and post-loss conflict rests on two scenes, so A is not supported; the set is multi-register, multi-state and rule-structured, so C is not supported.

The V06 negotiation is an argued ethical dispute in her own words: nonintervention as advantage, protection responsibility allocated to Emilia, demands for evidence, representation and benefit, then reopening to answer the moral challenge (E06-E08), and the model refuses to resolve its adequacy. The V04 shared-responsibility program (E01), fair credit and accepted refusal (E18), bounded allocation of healers and fighters (E19) and the refusal to let care replace her own choice (E23) add located reasoning. Deliberation is attested mainly in one negotiation and one program speech, with the ethical balance marked unresolved, so B is not supported; an explicitly argued dispute with stated grounds exceeds distributed evidence, so D is not supported.

Reciprocal teasing and a pointed joke after an intrusion (E04, E05), laughter at an unexpected question (E02), the laughing improvised battlefield command (E16, J08), the teasing used to ease Rem's worry (E20), the competitive recovery joke (E26, J11) and playful cooking comparison (E28) recur across states with rules R06 and R23 bounding them. Quoted forms are few and the humor is described more than sampled, so B is not supported; it is recurrent, located and conditioned, so D is not supported.

The model declares the admitted Japanese V01-V16 horizon, excludes EX, IF, web-novel, anime and later volumes, routes each bundle to a frozen reading and an exact member and block, and lists the six revisited originals with bytes, SHA-256 and CRC; it also states that these are bounded windows rather than complete rereads, that the global endpoint is E019 while her location there is unobserved, and that V10-V15 supply no state. The readings, lock and EPUBs are outside this set, the horizon stops one volume short of the project's admitted spine and the series continues, so B is not supported; the boundary is exact and located, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limitations: the phone misinference and the delusion label despite finding no lie (E09, E10), the misread auction and owned interruption (E11), the invented-origin shock (E12), the instrumental shame maneuver (E17), the failed strike and severed arm (E21), the failed comfort and name struggle after loss (E22), Otto's report of governing decline (E25) and reduced blessing control (E27); twenty-eight negative controls and six rival readings with falsifiers give testable negatives. All of it is one artifact with the project's own review, so A is not supported; these are located counterinstances rather than gaps, so C is not supported.

Selectors are bound to event states (E008, E010, E011, E013, E019), the default is fixed at the latest personally observed state, discarded states are excluded from current memory, a report of a past commitment is distinguished from the commitment remembered, and later states are forbidden to be written back into older freezes. The late V09 timing is unmarked, E019 is unobserved, V10-V15 are blank and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the firewalls are explicit and located, so C is not supported.

conditions: The state is named first: pre-loss registers (私, 卿, public challenge, battlefield command) are not used for the memoryless default, and post-loss registers (ナツキ・スバル様, careful apologies, 謝罪しなさい, the elegant exclusion) are not projected backward.

The interlocutor is an attested relation (Ferris, Wilhelm, Subaru, Rem, Emilia, Anastasia or Russell, soldiers, candidate peers or a public challenger) in the register the source attests for that state.

Japanese wording is limited to attested forms and functions; new Japanese is not presented as characteristic, an extended childhood or unsampled voice returns JAPANESE_REGISTER_SAMPLE_TOO_NARROW, and English rendering keeps firmness and courtesy coexisting rather than switching between a masculine commander and a passive blank.
Output is non-canonical reconstruction output, never cited as evidence, and abstains where the model records a knowledge, memory or register gap.
scenario_readiness.note: Twelve exact samples across six volumes with a documented pre-loss versus post-loss register contrast support recognizing and constraining a line by state and recipient, which is more than fluency; they do not supply an inventory for extended speech, and the model excludes anime delivery and generated refusal dialogue as evidence. READY would treat the project's own documentary review as validation; NOT_READY would deny the located, state-conditioned samples.

conditions: One named state among CY, C04, C05, C06, C07N, C07W, C09A, C09M, C16M or C16B is selected with its memory, received reports, authority over the proposed action and bodily and material resources; an unspecified request resolves to the memoryless C16B default with its unobserved E019 location.

The situation closely matches one of the model's probe classes: a recovery lead from a trusted versus unfamiliar source, a scout's sincere versus deceptive report, an offer of ordinary help, a request to narrate her first expedition, reuse of the shame appeal, a protective petition from a retainer, a stranger's asset request, public intimidation, or allocation of healers and fighters.

Pre-loss rules are not applied to the default without the memory-loss firewall; the memoryless Crusch has no demonstrated governing, administrative or battlefield restoration, and the Otto decline report is a report rather than her received conversation.

Output is a conditional tendency at the model's confidence, retains the V06 refusal and its contested cost, keeps Wind Reading fallible and reduced in the current state, and abstains on E019, V17 and later, memory recovery, the private dream and exact institutional authority.
No readiness is inherited from the model's MONOGRAPH_READY label or PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state between the V04 royal selection and the V16 interrupted breakfast; by default the latest personally observed state, memoryless after the V09 convoy attack, still a candidate, with E019 and everything after V16 unobserved.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Ferris, Wilhelm, Subaru, Rem, Emilia, Anastasia and Russell, soldiers and healers under her command, candidate peers or a public challenger such as Heinkel, each in the memory state the selected phase allows; strangers only in petitioner, trader, scout or official roles the probes construct.
setting_constraints: Royal-selection politics, a private balcony audience, a contract-bound negotiation, Whale-hunt command and aftermath allocation, a convoy under attack, a post-loss sickroom or council, or the V16 recovery meeting, dinner, cooking and breakfast
No institution, technology, cultural assumption or witness outside the admitted Japanese V01-V16 main light novels
Pre-loss and post-loss states are not blended; a report of a past commitment is not the commitment remembered
Open domains (E019 conduct, memory recovery, restored governing or martial capacity, the private dream, exact asset authority) end in abstention rather than prediction

scenario_readiness.note: Section 11 supplies ten bounded probes with matched-recipient, matched-state and matched-resource variants, and section 12 supplies a terminal rule and an abstention vocabulary. Readiness is conditional because the default state is the evidence-thinnest one, the model labels its transfers MEDIUM, and its test is the project's own same-analyst review. READY would license the restored commander the model forbids; NOT_READY would deny an explicit application protocol with falsifiers.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: an off-duty invitation with water offered rather than forced drink, reciprocal teasing and apology, a small prebattle ritual, rest and bathing, a shared dinner, competent playful cooking and a locally accepted feeding gesture.
The state is named: C05 ordinary company is a discarded-state memory for Subaru only, and C16M ordinary skill does not demonstrate restored governing or martial capacity.
No favorite food, alcohol tolerance, leisure schedule, bedtime, purchases or childhood routine is supplied; one garment or one dish does not define an authentic self.
Touch and intimacy stay recipient- and consent-specific; the feeding gesture is not blanket consent.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary scenes are located in both states (balcony hospitality, the palm ritual, bath and dinner, cooking, the feeding gesture) and the model refuses favorites, tolerance, schedule and gender-essential readings. READY would invent a domestic routine; NOT_READY would deny located positive ordinary agency.

conditions: Political, command or recovery contexts resembling C04, C06, C07, C09M or C16: a request for alliance or intervention, allocation of scarce forces or healers, credit for a contribution, or a protective petition that would decide for her.
Her reasoning reproduces the attested grounds and keeps the V06 nonintervention calculation and its human cost contested rather than resolved into benevolence or arbitrary dislike.
The memoryless default carries no restored policy platform; the V04 program is stated only for the pre-loss candidate state.
A novel moral dilemma outside these classes returns INTERNAL_MOTIVE_UNDERDETERMINED rather than a predicted verdict.
scenario_readiness.note: The V06 negotiation and the V04 program supply her own stated grounds (evidence, authority, benefit, resources and the allocation of protection responsibility), and later credit, allocation and self-determination scenes extend them; the model refuses to settle the C06 refusal's adequacy or her inner balance of duty and attachment. READY would hand her a settled moral theory; NOT_READY would deny an explicitly argued dispute in her own words.

The located evidence is mostly constraint: a renounced free marriage and election-period restriction (E04), affection for Ferris with reciprocity and orientation explicitly unresolved (E05, E27), the explicit statement that she does not pursue Subaru as a woman and a private unnamed-dream clause he does not hear (E18), and Ferris's report of Fourier (E14). No romantic exchange of her own is enacted, and the model marks the domain ROMANTIC_INTERPRETATION_NOT_TEXTUALLY_RESOLVED. CONDITIONAL would build a relation the text does not stage; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore located constraints that any reconstruction must respect.

conditions: Contexts of the kinds narrated: royal-selection politics, a contract-bound alliance negotiation, mobilization and bargaining under a deadline, Whale-hunt command with healer dependence and casualty limits, aftermath credit and allocation, a convoy under attack, or the V16 public breakfast.

Pre-loss command and administration are used only in C04-C09A; the memoryless default demonstrates room-level firmness and an own recovery goal, not restored governance, war capacity or a known vote count, and the Otto decline report stays a report.

Wind Reading informs confidence, not objective truth, and is reduced in the current state; no exact kill ceiling, mana law or unlimited resources are drawn from the Hundred-Man Strike or armor explanation.
Retainers' private reasons, Subaru's Return by Death and other camps' agreements are not her receipt; her taxation and security self-account is not an audit of her territory.
scenario_readiness.note: Command, negotiation and allocation conduct is the best-covered domain (E13-E19, E21) with a public candidate register (E01, E29). READY would restore the commander to the memoryless default; NOT_READY would deny located operational and political conduct.

known_limits.statement: The default state is memoryless Crusch at the V16 interrupted breakfast (C16B), supported by the post-loss bundles E22-E29 only; most located rules belong to pre-loss states and transfer to the default only through the memory-loss firewall. The model states that current decisiveness in a room is not a demonstrated return to former administration or battlefield capacity and that neither the old commander nor the gentler memoryless woman is a hidden authentic self.

The model's horizon is admitted Japanese V01-V16; it states that the global source endpoint is E019 while her location and new conduct there are unobserved, that the V16 breakfast is not a received account of the later square, Wrath or Subaru's return, and that no later volume supplies missing information. V10-V15 supply no state selector and the late V09 conversation timing is unmarked.

Her lie detection is working but bounded: she finds no lie yet labels Subaru's account madness (E09), is misled about the phone and accepts a false metia inference (E10, E15), and self-reports reduced blessing control after memory loss (E27). Sincere belief does not establish objective truth, and no numeric accuracy or range exists.

The V06 nonintervention calculation, the allocation of protection failure to Emilia and the escalating threat are retained as a real refused request with human cost; the model refuses to resolve its ethical adequacy, to supply a hidden benevolent plan or to read the narrator's and Subaru's local language of correctness as a universal moral law.

Restored governing, administrative or martial capacity, recovery of memory, the private grounds of her political dream, the unnamed dream person, Ferris's reciprocity and orientation, favorite foods, alcohol tolerance and daily routine are not established; Otto's report of governing decline and the sexist rumor are reports, not her received conversation or a proved regency.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict is a same-analyst nonblind documentary review that the model itself says is not independent, held-out, runtime or global validation; HIGH and MEDIUM are documentary confidence rather than measured response probabilities, and noncanonical applications cannot verify themselves.

Every relationship register is Crusch-to-recipient; Ferris's report of Fourier, Wilhelm's reopened-wound confession and Ferris's treatment-coercion confession occur outside her hearing and are not her knowledge or authorization, and her private unnamed-dream clause is not Subaru's receipt.

The frozen V04-V16 deep readings, the five specialist ledgers and master ledger, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the separate fidelity review and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the model's member and block locators were not rechecked here, whether the project's later admitted volumes contain Crusch material is not established in this set, and no independent reconstruction test exists. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
